FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Have questions? Here are answers to common queries.

Do I need to pay upfront?
▼
100% advance is required for small projects. Large projects (₹999+) require 50% advance with balance after delivery. Payment is secure — via UPI with receipt provided.
How much time does the work take?
▼
Basic package (500 rows) delivers in 1 day, Standard (2000 rows) in 2 days, and Premium (5000+ rows) in 3-5 days. Urgent delivery is also available for an extra charge.
Will my data be safe?
▼
Absolutely! Your data is never shared with anyone. Files are deleted after project completion. An NDA (Non-Disclosure Agreement) can also be signed if needed.
Are revisions free?
▼
Standard and Premium packages include unlimited free revisions. The Basic package includes 2 free revisions. If any error is on my end, revisions are always free.
Can you handle bulk projects?
▼
Yes! I handle bulk projects up to 10,000+ rows. Special pricing is available for large projects. Send sample data on WhatsApp for a free quote.
Which file formats do you deliver in?
▼
I can deliver in Excel (.xlsx), Google Sheets, Word (.docx), PDF, CSV — any format you need. Just let me know.
Are you available on Fiverr or Upwork?
▼
Yes! I am available on Fiverr as @rohitraj0402. However, ordering directly via WhatsApp or this website gives you better pricing as there are no platform fees.
